content: Canonical ports-and-adapters guidance (Cockburn, Garrido-Paz, Wikipedia): a port normally has several adapters, including a mock/fake one, and the mechanism that binds abstraction to concrete implementation is dependency injection performed once by a composition root at startup. Selection is a wiring concern, never a concern of the use cases. Adding a second adapter behind an existing port is therefore expected use of the pattern, not an extension of it.
